mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week climb in WORKPLACES mobility (from -45.1 to -36.1) shows commuter routines re-forming, which mechanically restores weekday foot traffic to retail corridors and pushes RETAIL_REC above its trailing 28-day mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -45.1 to -36.1 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is at or below the trailing 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES staying above -40 through the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovery is the binding constraint on discretionary trips: once TRANSIT crosses above -50, consumers regain enough trip capacity to shop in person, so RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -50.0 or rises more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -58.1 at t-2w to -49.0 at t-1w, crossing -50
regime_hint: moderate reopening with transit capacity restored
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its trailing 28-day mean within 14 days after TRANSIT first prints above -50.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of falling RESIDENTIAL (18.6 to 13.7) and rising TRANSIT is a time-use substitution out of the home into out-of-home activity, and that substitution leaks into retail visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls at least 2 points week-on-week while TRANSIT rises in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell 18.0 to 13.7 while TRANSIT rose -58.1 to -48.4 over the same two weeks
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL falls >2 points and TRANSIT rises, the following week's RETAIL_REC is not higher than the prior week's in a majority of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-December 2020 case growth forces new capacity restrictions that cap in-person retail; the first visible symptom is a week-on-week stall in WORKPLACES, which then drags RETAIL_REC down over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean falls more than 3 points week-on-week while TRANSIT also declines
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES already flattened (-35.1 to -36.1) between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or above the trailing 28-day mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fell week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: Late-December holiday gift and food purchasing is calendar-forced and lifts RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM in the first week, independent of epidemiological conditions; the lift is short-lived.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2020-12-15 falls inside the holiday shopping window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC for the week ending nearest 2020-12-25 is not above the t-0w value of -39.9.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in PARKS below -10 marks winter weather that pushes leisure activity indoors, and indoor leisure spending substitutes into retail-and-recreation venues within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean stays below -10.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS printed -17.7 at t-1w and -14.3 at t-0w, both below -10
failure_condition: With PARKS held below -10 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC declines or stays flat over the following 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in GROCERY_PHARM (-16.0 to -11.4) and RETAIL_REC (-62.0 to -39.9) shows households cutting back on pure necessity-only trips and re-expanding basket variety; this breadth effect sustains RETAIL_REC gains over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by at least 3 points relative to its value four weeks earlier
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 16.0 to 11.4 points below baseline while RETAIL_REC improved 62.0 to 39.9 below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the trailing 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM has improved by 3 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: If renewed stay-at-home orders land, they will first suppress TRANSIT and WORKPLACES further below their t-0w values, and the suppressed trip base caps RETAIL_REC below its trailing 28-day mean for the full four-week window.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises back above 16.0 or TRANSIT falls back below -52.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL reached 18.6 at t-3w when TRANSIT was -58.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days equals or exceeds the trailing 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL is above 16.0 or TRANSIT is below -52.0.
